# zone_domain (Resource)

Settings of a registered domain.

This is a settings resource, not a registration resource: the API exposes a domain's renewal and signing preferences, and nothing that would buy, transfer or release one. Almost every field below is therefore read-only.

~> **This resource does not create or destroy anything.** The zone.eu API has no endpoint for either: the object exists because a domain or service was bought, and it goes away with it. Applying this resource adopts what already exists and manages its settings; destroying it stops managing those settings and leaves everything in place.

~> **The update path for this resource is unverified.** zone.eu's published API description declares no request body for it, so the payload is inferred from the shape of a read, and exercising it would have changed a production service. It may need correcting; please report what happens.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Adopts a domain that is already registered and manages its settings. This
# resource cannot register, transfer or release a domain: the API has no
# endpoint for any of that.
resource "zone_domain" "example" {
  name = "example.com"

  # Renewal reminders by email.
  renewal_notifications = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Domain name, for example `example.com`. Changing this adopts a different domain.

### Optional

- `renewal_notifications` (Boolean) Whether zone.eu sends renewal reminders for this domain.
- `signing_required` (Boolean) Whether DNSSEC signing is required for this domain.

The API accepts this but never returns it, so it cannot be refreshed: Terraform keeps whatever was last applied and will not notice a change made in the ZoneID panel. Leave it unset to not manage it at all.

### Read-Only

- `auth_key_enabled` (Boolean) Whether this TLD uses an authorisation key for transfers.
- `autorenew` (Boolean) Whether zone.eu renews the domain automatically. Set in the ZoneID panel.
- `delegated` (String) The ZoneID username this domain is delegated to, or null when it is not delegated.
- `dnssec` (Boolean) Whether the domain is DNSSEC signed.
- `dnssec_supported` (Boolean) Whether the registry supports DNSSEC for this TLD.
- `expired` (Boolean) Whether the registration has lapsed.
- `expires` (String) When the registration expires, as an ISO 8601 timestamp.
- `has_pending_dnssec` (Boolean) Whether a DNSSEC change is still being applied at the registry.
- `has_pending_trade` (Number) Identifier of an in-progress trade, or null when there is none.
- `nameservers_custom` (Boolean) Whether the domain uses nameservers other than zone.eu's. Read-only here: the API documents that only `false` may be written, and the delegation itself is managed with `zone_domain_nameservers`.
- `reactivate` (Boolean) Whether an expired domain can still be reactivated.
- `renew_order` (String) The pending renewal order, or null when there is none.
- `resource_url` (String) API URL of this domain.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# A domain is imported by its name.
terraform import zone_domain.example "example.com"
```
